name: Vasudeva 2015
question: For long-segment incomplete bulbar urethral stricture, how do dorsal and ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty compare?

arms.label: Dorsal onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty
ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty

design.population: Patients with long-segment (>2 cm), incomplete bulbar urethral stricture meeting the study's eligibility criteria.

verdictNote: The abstract gives no prespecified endpoint or superiority threshold.
takeaway: In 80 patients with long-segment incomplete bulbar stricture, dorsal versus ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty yielded 12-month surgical success of 92.5% versus 90%; the reported difference was not statistically significant.

reports.label: Initial randomized report
reports.citation: Vasudeva P, Nanda B, Kumar A, et al. "Dorsal versus ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty for long-segment bulbar urethral stricture: A prospective randomized study." *Int J Urol.* 2015;22(10):967-971. doi:10.1111/iju.12859

results.measure: 12-month surgical success; definition not supplied in abstract
results.note: Forty patients were randomized per arm; assessed denominators and a prespecified success threshold were not reported.

results.measure: Reported percentage improvement in mean IPSS at 12 months
results.note: The abstract reports no significant between-group difference at 3 or 12 months; percentage-improvement calculation is unspecified.

results.measure: Reported percentage improvement in mean Qmax at 12 months
results.note: The abstract reports no significant between-group difference at 3 or 12 months; baseline and absolute follow-up flow values are not supplied.
